recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future gaps in package-specific conversion rules should be addressed in the cross-version package process or FHIR Extension Pack, not by restoring duplicate guidance in core versions.html.
issue_request: FHIR-31721 asked the FHIR-core versions compatibility section to clarify practical rules for implied/cross-version extensions, including renamed or unavailable reference targets, unsupported datatypes and choices, source-extension propagation, cardinality behavior, and broken package links.
initial_application: Commit 254ea0c87356baddf7f1da9c0a8fdbc91ca6a27f directly applied FHIR-31721 by expanding source/versions.html with alternate-reference/canonical, _datatype, cardinality, primitive mapping, and complex-extension guidance; the R5 published page still contains that detailed prose.
additional_context: Current core was later refactored by f45505e5b3aa0d87effb991938750e627b782d2d, which explicitly moved cross-version content out to guides. The active versions page now gives a concise package overview and matrix while standard extension definitions and xver package-specific guidance live in the FHIR Extension Pack and xver guide/package artifacts.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-adding the removed detailed text to source/versions.html would duplicate the current xver package/guide source of truth and risk drift, while current core remains accurate by pointing to the individual cross-version definition packages.
